name: Russian River Valley
blurb: Cool fog-influenced AVA; Pinot Noir and Chardonnay are signatures, with Green Valley as a cooler nested AVA.

name: Alexander Valley
blurb: Warmer northern Sonoma valley along the Russian River; Cabernet Sauvignon leads, with Merlot and Chardonnay.

name: Dry Creek Valley
blurb: Classic Zinfandel AVA west of Healdsburg; also Cabernet and Sauvignon Blanc. Warm days, cooling evening breezes.

name: Sonoma Valley
blurb: Historic valley from Carneros north past Sonoma town; Cabernet, Pinot, Chardonnay, and Zinfandel. Home of Buena Vista (1857).

name: Sonoma Coast
blurb: Broad cool-climate AVA hugging the Pacific; Pinot Noir and Chardonnay in windy, foggy sites (includes parts overlapping other AVAs).

name: Knights Valley
blurb: Warm inland AVA between Alexander Valley and Napa’s Calistoga; Cabernet-focused mountain/valley sites.

name: Green Valley of Russian River
blurb: Cool nested AVA in western Russian River Valley; Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, often for sparkling base wines.

name: Chalk Hill
blurb: Northeast of Santa Rosa; volcanic ash/chalky soils, Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc with some Cabernet.
